news.title: Mark Stone becomes Golden Knight's all-time scoring leader in loss to Stars

news.title: Kirill Kaprizov, Quinn Hughes extend point streaks to 13 games in Wild's 4-1 win over the Flames
news.ruTitle: Кирилл Капризов и Куинн Хьюз увеличили очковую серию до 13 игр в победе «Уайлд» над «Флэймз» со счетом 4:1
news.description: — Kirill Kaprizov and Quinn Hughes extended their point streaks to 13 games to lead the Minnesota Wild to a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames on Thursday night.

news.title: Kings rally from 3 down to beat skidding Maple Leafs 4-3 on Kempe's goal in shootout
news.ruTitle: «Кингз» набрали счет со счетом 3 и обыграли «Мэйпл Лифс» со счетом 4–3 после гола Кемпе в серии пенальти.
news.description: — Adrian Kempe scored the only goal in a shootout and the Los Angeles Kings roared back from a three-goal deficit to beat Toronto 4-3 on Thursday night, handing the Maple Leafs their eighth straight defeat.

news.title: Blue Jackets end 5-game skid with 4-2 win over Blackhawks
news.ruTitle: «Блю Джекетс» завершили неудачу в пяти матчах победой над «Блэкхокс» со счетом 4:2
news.description: — Zach Werenski scored and added an assist, Kent Johnson, Matthew Knies and Adam Fantilli also scored, and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the Chicago Blackhawks 4-2 on Thursday night.

news.title: Travis Konecny scores in OT to cap Flyers' rally from 3 goals down to beat Senators 6-5
news.ruTitle: Трэвис Конечни забивает в овертайме и ограничивает счет Флайерз с разницей в 3 гола и обыгрывает сенаторов со счетом 6-5.
news.description: — Travis Konecny scored 39 seconds into overtime to cap a four-point night, and the Philadelphia Flyers rallied from a 5-2 deficit to beat the Ottawa Senators 6-5 on Thursday night.

news.title: Connor McDavid's 23-game point streak ends as Oilers fall to Lightning
news.ruTitle: Очковая серия Коннора Макдэвида из 23 игр завершилась, когда «Ойлерз» проиграли «Лайтнинг»
news.description: Connor McDavid, who opened the season on a 23-game scoring streak, was held off the scoresheet for the first time this season in the Oilers' 3-1 loss to the Lightning.
